_comment: Current distribution used by extract_rz_model.py. The DD4hep coil volumes are passive (no current): the
geometry gives where the conductor is, this file gives how the ampere-turns are distributed in it.
main_coil: the CLEO-II winding (DD4hep MagnetCoil/CoilWinding, r 151.70-154.90 cm, z +-173.75 cm) holds
n_layers equal radial layers (2 x 1.6 cm conductor). Each layer carries its current in a sheet of
sheet_thickness_cm centred on the layer mid-radius (the Cu/NbTi insert in the middle of the Al-stabilised
conductor), i.e. 152.30-152.70 and 153.90-154.30 cm, as in CLEOv8/9/10.am. null = uniform over the layer.
The axial grading (turns per section and section edges) is taken from CLEOv10.am; the section edges are
mapped linearly from the deck coil length (+-173.8) onto the DD4hep winding length.
aux_coils: conductor volumes that exist in the DD4hep yoke (matched by volume-name regex).
addon_coils: coils that are NOT in the DD4hep geometry, added only on request (--addon-coil NAME).

main_coil.source: solid_gemc/field/CLEOv10.am (also CLEOv8/v9.am): 1282 turns x 3266 A, 2 x (166 + 309 + 166) turns, current sheets r 152.3-152.7 / 153.9-154.3 cm, z +-173.8 / +-85.5 cm

aux_coils.name: CorrectionCoil
aux_coils.source: solenoid_v4.xml CorrectionCoil (GEMC v4 'coilcorr', Cu, r 40-49 cm, z -277..-268 cm). Its current in the 2022 TOSCA v4 model (J. Benesch, JLab-TN 22-011/014) is not available (solenoid_v4.dat and the notes are not in the repositories), so the default is 0 A-turns (air). Set it with --aux-ni CorrectionCoil=<A-turns>.

cleov11_correction_coil.source: 'CLEO-II Stage 1 and 2.html' (POISSON runs 2026-10-31), CLEOv11 (stage 2A) region 'Correction coil': mat=1, cur=-16240, z -286.5..-266.5, r 40.0-47.5 (150 cm2, J = 108.3 A/cm2, 1.17 kW, air cooled) on an aluminium support ring r 38.937-39.572 (non-magnetic, not modelled). Tuned for the CLEOv11 plug (z -266.5..-240.375, 25 deg bore), which is not the iron of solenoid_lite_sidis.xml.

cleov12_correction_coil.source: 'CLEO-II Stage 1 and 2.html', CLEOv12 (stage 2B) 'Correction coil': cur=-16166 (J = 107.8 A/cm2), same geometry as CLEOv11.
